title: [OCT25] Everyday Relationships - Sunday 11am
message:
Noone likes to be told what to do.  So, when we hear "commands" from the bible,
we immediately feel defensive or defeated.  Yet we hear in 1 John 5.1-5 God's
commands are not burdensome. What does it look like to be God's NEW CREATION
that obeys God's commands?  See you Sunday!

 

Blessings!

Jorge
author: Jeffrey Teng
